exposure: Knowledge of blood donations and transfusions
Awareness of Autologous Blood Donation and Transfusions (ABDT)
outcome: Acceptance of Autologous Blood Donation and Transfusions (ABDT) for scheduled surgeries
Willingness to become voluntary blood donors after surgery
cohort: The study included 171 patients scheduled for elective orthopaedic, gynaecologic, and elective caesarean section surgeries at a tertiary hospital in North Central Nigeria.
finding: Despite low awareness, 47.4% of subjects accepted Autologous Blood Donation and Transfusions (ABDT) for their scheduled surgeries, with pre-deposit being the most preferred form.
cross-section timing: Prior to elective orthopaedic, gynaecologic, and elective caesarean section surgeries.
